## Context / immutable audit base
At d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1, these five files contain 36 confirmed bloated prose blocks. The former older-SHA ranges mixed executable code, section labels, directives, and concise/load-bearing docs while missing long read, ancestry, graph, and op-cert explanations. Lines are immutable-base citations only.

## Exact prose allowlist

## Contracts, consumers, and exclusions
Preserve the single read implementation, sort/null rules, relocated-store resolution, short-lock freshness, throttle-before-sync, inbound-edge derivation, show/list/search shape, lean omission set, filtering, Jira-key enrichment, and session-log ordering. Preserve oldest-add commit semantics, full-history/no-merge/no-rename walks, record framing, map fallback, and fail-closed resolution. Preserve link idempotency/cycle/promotion/reciprocal semantics and durable-write-before-output order. Preserve op-cert async API/authentication, app-owned executor shutdown, authoritative workspace, git/stall bounds, boot lock budget, and stripped remotes.

No allowlisted docstring is directly read via __doc__/inspect.getdoc. FastAPI does consume the decorated health/submit_job/get_job docstrings for OpenAPI; those concise docs are deliberately outside the allowlist. Preserve reads.py tickets-boundary-ok line 122 and BLE001 lines 295/297/549; authorship_resolution.py BLE001 lines 64/112/208/288/366; _links.py T201 line 258; app.py BLE001 line 202; workspace.py raw-git-ok lines 58/88. All other non-allowlisted prose, runtime strings, assertions, fixtures, decorators, subprocess arguments, config keys/values, directives, and shebangs remain byte-identical.

## Verification and independent review
Use d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1 only to identify and cite the 36 audited prose blocks. Parse the implementation parent (HEAD^) and final Python with type_comments=True; strip only allowlisted owner docstrings, normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno, and require remaining AST/runtime equality plus directive/shebang physical-line equality. Require exact HEAD^..HEAD paths. Before push, run the focused read/ancestry/link/op-cert contracts, the exact-path diff check, comment hygiene, worktree-venv make lint, and worktree-venv make typecheck. Gerrit Verified CI supplies the full-suite gate before merge.

A non-author reviewer records a leaf-linked TSV with exactly 36 PASS rows: stable_id, before_citation, final_citation, preserved_contract_or_consumer, directives_exact, before_words, final_words, reviewer_session, semantic_pass, bloat_pass. Every block must shrink.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly the 36 allowlisted prose blocks are shortened.
- [ ] Every allowlisted block has a lower final word count than its cited before version.
- [ ] Every non-allowlisted docstring remains unchanged.
- [ ] Every non-allowlisted ordinary comment remains unchanged.
- [ ] Every directive and shebang physical line remains unchanged.
- [ ] The implementation-parent/final AST/runtime oracle passes for all five files.
- [ ] The implementation-parent/final ordinary-comment token oracle passes for all five files.
- [ ] Every preserved read, ancestry, graph, op-cert, and workspace contract has an independent-review PASS citation.
- [ ] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the five recorded file-impact paths.
